The issuer exhibits strong profitability (EBIT margin of ~23.3%) and a healthy short-term liquidity profile with a current ratio of 1.35x. However, the balance sheet reflects moderate leverage with a total liabilities-to-assets ratio of ~64.8% and total liabilities-to-equity of ~1.84x, which tempers the credit profile into the investment-grade BBB tier. Overall, the solid earnings generation relative to its asset base and manageable debt load support an upper-tier BBB rating.

DECISION: BBB+
